summary: Expanded the underfollowed universe around transmission-line hardware and adjacent tower-installed components. The strongest direct underfollowed candidate is PLPC, which manufactures conductor-support, protection, dead-end, damping, and splice-related products and explicitly cited AI-driven energy-order growth on the transmission side in its 2025 annual report. ACA and AZZ are second-order infrastructure suppliers tied to utility structures and galvanizing/coating gates rather than conductor fittings themselves. HUBB is included only as a larger reference competitor/context anchor because its Utility Solutions segment includes T&D components but the company is more diversified and higher-attention.
